FLE-001.title: The Fleeca Job

overview.target: Fleeca Bank — Great Ocean Highway Branch
overview.objective: Infiltrate Fleeca's security network, obtain access codes, and execute a coordinated robbery.

FLE-001.intel: Lester Crest begins assembling a professional crew capable of executing high-value criminal operations across Los Santos. The Fleeca Job serves as the first major heist operation, testing the crew's ability to perform reconnaissance, bypass security, coordinate transportation, and manage law enforcement response.

planningLocation.observation: Apartment Connection: 4 Integrity Way, Apartment 30. Visible Landmark: Fleeca Bank flags. Possible Connection: the apartment view appears to reference the first heist target.

setup.name: 1. Scope Out Fleeca Bank
setup.objective: Observe security systems and identify weaknesses.
setup.intel: Security cameras, vault location, guard positions, escape route
setup.dialogue:
There's a Fleeca franchise on the Western Highway near Chumash. Take us there.
Word of warning, we're on the job right now, so don't let the cops notice you. If they come after us, we call it off.

So, my taciturn friends, I suppose you want to know how we're doing this. Well, funny you should ask. We're driving out to the bank, taking a look at it, picking up some equipment, and then heading back to make our plans. Not very complex at all. We're not going in, we're not poking it with a stick, we're just sitting back and taking a look. You see, I like my scores like I like my dates – across the street and unaware they’re being watched.

Alright, so why this bank, over all the other banks in the state, why does fortune favour this one? Another good question. You're full of good questions. You're like a child whose parents think it's clever, or the IRS. Well, this bank’s got some safety deposit boxes, and in one of those boxes are some bonds being hidden from the tax man, that no one's going to report missing. All starting to make sense?

Security should be like, well, relatively light, if your day dreams are raids on the Union Depository. Quite heavy, if your day job is turning over liquor stores and gas stations. And the bonds in the box will be worth more than a few rumpled notes from the till, so, the minor escalation is worth it... if you can handle it. Plus, you know, the seaview. Nothing like staring at the ocean while you contemplate money and power and incarceration, and homicide, you know, all those weighty issues in your first foray into serious armed robbery. I'm assuming you're a kind of cerebral crew, because otherwise, this whole not talking to you just kind of put you on the spectrum, right? Okay, well, how about we just get there and see where we're at.

There it is. Take a look. Drink it in. I've patched into the security feed on my cell. Take a look. What are we looking at? Small joint. Not much security. Staff won’t give a crap, especially about the deposit boxes. Customers will probably be thinking how to turn this into a screenplay. The boxes are in the back behind the safe door. We want box number 167. It's right on the highway with good access. That'll work for you, you can get out quick. But it'll also work for the cops, speeds up the response time. Okay? Okay. Enough of this peeper crap. Let's go to the Garment Factory.

Now, when you hit the bank, you're going to need to hack into its security system. I've written a neat little program that'll do most of the work for you, but it's probably a good idea to familiarize yourselves with it. You in the passenger seat, I’ve sent it to your phone (BitterSweet). Take it for a dry run, keep your hands steady, and maybe the wet run won't be a disaster.
I'm calling Paige. She's my assistant. First, she's going to get us what we need, and then she's going to saw me in half. Hahaha. No? Didn't like that one? Huh, you don't make it easy.

Paige, it's Lester... Place looked good. Nothing we weren't expecting… Can you get the Intel together? Hard copies to go on a notice board... Yeah. Plus all the equipment we spoke about. I'll be over to collect it with those people... Yeah...Mmm, charming as ever...Okay, see you soon. Hey passenger seat, get into their network? Good work. She's loading the hardware into the back of a truck (Declasse Granger). Tools for the job, things for you to wear. On a job, your attire will depend on the role you're performing. As the jobs get more complicated, so will the uniforms. If you're likely to be seen by civilians, you'll be provided with a couple of masks, then, when you go into the bank, you can choose one that... goes with your eyes . And hey, there's the added bonus of none of your favourite comic convention outfits being linked to a major crime. Haha, whoop-dee-doo. Where were we? Masks! Paige! Oh yeah. We'll go over there, pick her up, and go back to your place to plan this thing. There's Paige. We're leaving this car, taking the truck. I should be using my cane.

Paige: 
Nice to meet you.

Lester:
Come on. Back to your place.

Lester: 
Is it all there?

Paige:
I think so... You wanna get out and check, go down the inventory? Or are you happy sitting there making a perfect butt imprint on your easy-wipe seat?

Lester:
I’ll take your word for it.

Paige:
Thank you. It should all be there. The clothes. Guns. Headsets, Masks, The Drill. The files with all the photos and surveillance work. Hey, there’s enough here to make us all look real suspicious. Nice little conspiracy to commit robbery charge waiting to happen.

Lester:
What, they gonna charge us with thought crime?

Paige:
Not so much thought as everything-but-the-deed-crime. We’d be caught with our pants down and a hard on out to here.

Lester:
Well, we’re not getting caught. These are professionals.

Paige:
So I hear. The cheapest professionals money can buy.

Lester:
I like to think of it as investing in new talent. She didn't mean anything by that, by the way. She’s just a little brusque.

Paige:
If they were offended, they would’ve said something.

setup.name: 2. Kuruma
setup.objective: Acquire an armored vehicle for the robbery.
setup.dialogue:
Okay, okay, okay. Now, Paige will set up a board for you, won't you Paige? 

Paige
But you’d do it if you could reach. I mean, I didn't see any milk crates for you to stand on. 

Lester
The most important thing to look for in an employee is respect. You can’t get anything done without respect. Where was I oh, yes, yes, the room. Paige is setting up this board on which you will plan your scores. You'll use it to set out all the prep work you need to do, select your crew, figure out how to take from a score. How it should be split up. Need a crew to take a score, but only one person can be in charge. Respect. Isn’t that right, Paige?

Paige
Blow me.

Lester
Alright, you're only going to need one thing for this job, it's a high speed armored car. Instead of getting one legitimately leaving a nice long paper trail to your front door, you're going to be jacking one from a nasty Korean crew and leaving a nice long paper trail to their door instead. Good to go. Here's your board, good, good, good. When you're ready to move on the car, go over it, study the plan, tick it off the list. Even methodical, this isn't just a dumb crime. Well there there is an element of that, huh? And when you've got the car we'll come back here and talk, bank jobs, bank jobs, bank jobs.

Hello, can you hear me? I'll be here to talk you through all these jobs. Oh, what do we got here? Oh, yeah, the car. Okay. You're on the way to Del Perro. A Koreatown stick up crew’s been using a parking lot as a base for scores. Now, they're into extortion, credit fraud, stolen cars, and some mini major robberies. I'd expect them to be packing and I’d expect them to be paranoid. Come to think of it, you won’t find a billetproof car in the hands of anyone who doesn’t have a healthy dose of paranoia. You almost there? Remember, you can do this however you like, as long as you're careful. If you're not careful, they'll clock you, and then you won't get any choice how this is going down. They're meant to be on the top level of this garage on the north side, so I see two ways of doing it. You go up to north ramps and hit them hard and quick, or you go up the South ramp, get in position, and try to get the drop on them. From cover you can do whatever you like as long as you get it done. Oh yeah, we don't want anyone looking for you, so put on masks before saying hi. You got the car? Now drop any cops or gangsters or whoever you've got coming after you, and bring it to my garment factory. and try not to damage the car too much. You can't rob a bank in a wrecked car. how's the driving? I don't want to call this an idiot proof heist car. I mean there's no limit to some people's stupidity, but you gotta be very fucking dumb to let the cops catch you in one of these. it's got muscle, traction, lightweight armor that shouldn't compromise performance, this is the one for us. Now get it back in one piece and all shut up about it. How are you doing? Paige’s going to meet you under the bridge near the factory. This score is coming together.

Paige
Okay. I'll look after this. Lester will come by your place when you're ready to go.

finalOperation.dialogue:
Ah your ah your first time you know the first time it's never easy there won't exactly be a fireworks, you know? Be vaguely awkward and disappointing, you know? You probably stick the wrong thing in the wrong part and you'll finish too early, and... and.. you won't be able to make eye contact afterwards, but, but new worlds will.. will open up, something will have changed, you know? New opportunities, new risks, and that's when you'll remember that old Uncle Lester was here for you holding your hand guiding you through it, and you'll feel a little creeped out but you're going to repress it. wash it down. I never talk about it.

Okay, okay, okay. First time Fleeca. It's a two man score, right. One of you drives keeps the heat off of you. The other goes into the bank goes to the specific safety deposit box then you get out of there you get in that fast armored car and you get the hell out of that place, and once you're clean, once you got no heat on you, come see me, give me the box and get paid. I can tell you right now, you know what, like I said it is your first time so don't expect too much. There are wild insane mind blowing orgies in your future orgies. But uh, we all gotta start somewhere. Good luck.

Okay, here we go. I'm excited for you. I've got goosebumps up my arms and butterflies in my stomach, and a light film of sweat on my upper lip. Do you know where you left the car? At least I hope you do. You weren't drunk on painkillers we’re you, no no that was me. Driller, I'm sending you that hacking program when you get in the car you need to get on it and start breaking into their system. You got the wheels? Alright, go to the bank. Driller start hacking their network, you need to establish a connection before you get to the bank, then you'll be able to trigger the vault door remotely the hacking programs cleaning up after you so you can take as many shots as you want and they won't know they're being attacked. Once you walk through those doors there's no turning back. Well actually there's no turning back right now, because I put a lot of work into this and I'll be really really annoyed with you if you don't go through with it. You know, I probably refuse to speak to you for a week and then spread nasty rumors behind your back and maybe set up a lifeinvader page about what a creep you are, you know. Be scary if I said I’d kill you wouldn't it? Happen at the age of the Internet when nothing is forgotten and humiliation is worse than death in a way. No, it’s not, is it? I should have made a death threat or like a mutilation threat. Said I’d, you know, here and cut off your nose or use your ass as an ashtray or do something with your tongue, not that you use your tongue. The next pair of mutes I try to help into a career of crime, I'll make sure I threaten. So since we’re actually doing this, I’m going to talk you through it one last time. We’re giving you pump action shotguns to take in, they should look intimidating enough. You go in, you go in hard. There are 4 security cameras in the foyer. Driver, take them out as soon as you walk in the door. Then you’re on crowd control. Driller, when you’re in the network you’ll be able to open the vault door on your phone. Go back to the safety deposit room and start drilling. You at the bank? You need to wait until the driller has got into their network before making a move. How’s the hack coming? You should have it done by now. Okay, time to open the vault. Take out your phone and trigger the door. Here we go. Put on a mask if you haven't already and get inside. 

Take out the cameras, quick. You’ll be broadcasting live to the LSPD if you don’t shut them down. Okay, now, find that safety depository box. There it is. Drill it. Okay found the box? Okay, go in your bag and get out the drill. get and there it is drill it you don't have to wait you found the box OK go in your bag get out the drill. Okay, dont go to quick, it’s going to overheat. If you see smoke ease off. If the drill burns out, this whole thing will take to long. Keep going we need that box. How are you doing with that drill? That’s the box be ready to move. 

Go Go Go, you didn't come this far to end up in the back of a squad car. I’ve got my getaway guy waiting for you on Zancudo Bridge. He's got a plan for the cops if you can just get there. Guys name is Eddie Toe, he's a professional. He’ll take care of everything. Okay, come in. This is your getaway guy. Lester tells me you are inbound. Keep driving for the bridge; I got this under control. We have lift off. Let’s go. 

Show it to me. Yes, it is the holiday season at the Crest residence, and daddy’s out drinking. Say you passed. And if that thing I talked about comes up, I’ll call you. In the meantime, if anyone comes to me, I’ll mention you as a reliable pair of hands. Hey, for a first time that wasn’t bad, but don’t get too clingy.

roles.duties: Controls escape vehicle, manages getaway
Opens safety deposit box area, handles vault access

PRI-002.title: The Prison Break

overview.objective: Break Professor Maxim Rashkovsky out of Bolingbroke Penitentiary and get him out of the country.

PRI-002.intel: Agent 14 outlines the setup jobs needed before the breakout: securing an aircraft for Rashkovsky's escape flight, hijacking a prison transport bus, obtaining the inmate transfer schedule, retrieving Rashkovsky's car from a rival theft ring, and cleaning up loose ends connected to his case.
PRI-002.dialogue:
Mr. Crest said we should talk about work but not here Is there a room in the back or something cool I'll get set so Mr Crest said you might be able to help me out with something Well not me so that's clear it's not me you're gonna be helping and I want to understood that I am not involved just a bystander doing a favor and this is not an offer of employment so much as an opportunity well anyway that's just getting a bit technical but the point is sometimes they're fair and legal justice system makes mistakes and this is one such time here he is professor Maxim Rashkovsky you know the professor used to be head of research for the Army Three doctorates overconfident polymath vain sociopath tedious egomaniac control freak geneticist weapons development engineer car nut but definitely not a people person accused of espionage along with everything else you don't remember well lucky you exceedingly vain and self absorbed man brilliant at everything he does yada yada yada makes you want to puke it's a **** **** traitor I mean he's a rat but he pays incarcerated for a crime he did commit but well let's just say money talks and he's going to walk so we got a few things to get ready all pretty straightforward do them one at a time but anyway you like standard op for gov fat breakouts you know what I mean. 

Alright, first thing's a plane, then we get a bus and then well two things we get the inmate transfer schedule and Rashkovsky's car. More on that later. Let me show you we need a plane to get the professor out of the country. It's currently being used to traffic drugs by transnational street gang The Vagos. 

The Bus is a standard Bolingbrook transport vehicle; the least traffic is on the route from Paleto Bay, alright, that's where we'll be able to get a hold of one. You can get a hard copy of the inmate transit schedule at the LSPD  mission row station. Go in unarmed, play it cool you might not have a problem. That's a 2 person job max. The other two handlers are guys prized casco. We believe it's about to be shipped to Korea by a luxury car theft ring. Okay, Mr. Crest said you guys are at least semi competent, so well,l Professor Rashkovsky pays well.

setup.name: 1. Plane
setup.objective: Fight through Vagos gang members at McKenzie Airfield to steal a Velum aircraft for Rashkovsky's escape flight.
setup.dialogue:
So you're moving on the plane. It's at Mackenzie Airfield Logistics undecided. Do what I like but go in with a good supply of ammunition armor and maybe even explosives. It’s gonna get kind of heavy. Like I said before the airfield is under Vago's control they're using a plane to make the runs across the border, that means, it's already set up to take Rashovsky out of the country, limited radar, visibility, plausible cover story - it's perfect. Don’t let the fact  there are a bunch of angry drug dealers waiting for you affect how you go in. Or actually do.

Some more background on the Vagos. OK Globalized Multi national decentralized criminal network. Their principle interest is in drug trafficking but they've diversified into mid level distribution and juicer sales and trafficking other contraband. You get caught with a kilo of coke, they throw the book at you. You caught with a quart of Capybara seamen its a slap on the wrist. And the market for a large and endangered rodent ejaculate is lucrative. Most of the Vago’s upper management shot callers if you like are already incarcerated here in the States and throughout Central and Latin America they run their network on cell phones that's a relatively flat hierarchy at the top.  So if you cut one head off there's 6 more waiting to bite Not that I want to dismantle any criminal networks as you know I'm a criminal myself. I just like to do my homework The prison angle is gonna help us sell our raid on Bolingbroke. It's not something that they would do but it's the kind of thing the authorities believe that they would do which is all that really matters you get me.

 OK I’m leading you close to the airfield, remember once you engage these bastards.There's only one way this is going to make a plan then execute it no matter how good the plan is expect sustained resistance. Maintaining the integrity of the plane is the priority here. Don't rush this.

setup.name: 2. Bus
setup.objective: Intercept and steal a Bolingbroke prison transport bus during a police pursuit, then stash it at a Sandy Shores junkyard.
setup.locations: Blaine County convoy route, Sandy Shores junkyard
setup.dialogue: Take an old school bus, paint it, bar the windows and make it smell like blood bowels at your brother's high school. sorry we could do that but it costs money and this is costing Rashkovsky enough already so you're hitting the transport and you're not second guessing us again.  Set to move they're holding inmate class national security risk Bad news is that means there's non security detail the good news is the authorities will think we're trying to break him out and they'll be distracted from what's really going on you read me OK so we need the bus interact so this way to do that would be neutralizing the driver just so you know. Ok looks like things are heating up.  you'll need to lose the police attention before you come anywhere near us again. Hows the bus no ones hiding in the back with a cell phone a carton of cigarettes a pint of pruno up his ass. Amazing what they can fit up there. The lifers especially. You know those games you play where someone gets out a rocket launcher and people go, where was he keeping that? It’s so unrealistic. I say that you've clearly not spent much time in the US prison system. Levity and pop culture references are useful tools when trying to gain trust of new associates. Nice. We’ll hold on to this for you.

setup.name: 3. Station
setup.objective: Split into two teams — one poses as cops at Mission Row Police Station for the inmate transfer schedule, the other retrieves Rashkovsky's Lampadati Casco from a cargo ship at the port.
setup.locations: Mission Row Police Station, Port of Los Santos
setup.dialogue:
OK we got two teams split up and hit your objectives. I'm setting up a healthy atmosphere of competitiveness, use that. Station team you're going for the Bolingbrook Transit schedule. You got the right uniforms but they'll be no good to you if you turn up on foot or in civilian transportation. Get a hold of a cop car using any means necessary, then you can go to the station. and I shouldn't need to say this, don’t get yourselves killed.

You got a car? Okay. Make sure no one is following you, You can’t turn up at the station when you’re wanted by the police, unless you’re turning yourself in, that is. Lose the cops.

From the looks of it you’re clear now go into the station and grab the hard copy on the way in you wont have a problem with the cops unless you act stupid. On the way out with the document, I don’t know. I would do this quickly if I were you just incase someone adds 2 and 2 and makes yeah. 

You got it? Alright get out of there  OK one more thing, I'm going to need you to torch the cop car  to stop this from coming back to us. There are some gas cans under the olympic freeway in Murrieta Heights that will do the job. 

You almost there? My drivers been mainlining Junk energy drinks and downloading soft rock classics for a 40 yard drive to Central America. She would really appreciate if you’d hurry up and send her on her way. 

Good work on the schedule but now you got to wait till the team on the car delivers it. Make yourselves useful or make yourself scarce. Okay.

Driver:
Hey. Out. I’m taking over.

setup.name: 4. Wet Work
setup.objective: Split into two teams to tie off loose ends — take out Rashkovsky's business associate Dima Popov, and two lawyers outside the FIB building for their deposition documents.
setup.dialogue:
Hey, good work people, great job. We're still in business very well done all of you very very non incriminating yes that's the word I'm looking for. Now it's ironic given we ah, ah, maybe now it's not the best time to discuss irony. God what is wrong with me you know? I'm usually such a high achiever. Or a criminal. So before we remove Professor Rashkovsky from his unwelcome stay in prison we've gotta clean up a few other loose ends pertaining to the case. Yes, it's a killing but no it's nothing immoral at all just lawyers. Well the professor's old business associate and two lawyers, but really it's all the same. I mean, I always say, if you can't kill a couple lawyers to bend the law to your will then who can you kill? Oh here they are gavin Van Dulu and Josh Sherman get them on the way to City Hall get the documents they're carrying business partner is Dima Popov, extremely rich extremely paranoid and extremely horrible. Don't cry for this guy, no one else will. He's renting a place up in Richmond Glen, just him and a huge security team get close to him take him down and after that we should be ready to go.

Lawyers

Final stretch now. It’s a 2 horse race with two of you in each horse the ass and the head. Horse one is going for the lawyers at City Hall. Horse 2 is on the business partner in Richman Sound good? Get moving. This one there's a ladder going up to the roof of the building opposite City Hall you've got your long range rifles right? You want to minimize risk of failure so you're taking your kills at exactly the same time. Coordinate your shots. Climb the ladder get in position on the rooftop.You got a clear view of the steps? Van Der Loop and Sherman are en route in a black Benefactor Shafter. Do not shoot until they are out of the car.

Do not bring those documents anywhere near the apartment until you are sure the police are not following you. Copy? Sounds like the locals have given up their pursuit. Good work team. The other team just cleaned up at Popov’s house. Bring the deposition back in. 


Popov

Alright you're going in on the quiet. Gain access to the estate. Bring down Popov when you get up close. 

It’s not paranoia, it’s being prepared. Stupid. Maybe that’s why I’m not the asshole in the jail, huh? Yeah. Okay.

Team one took out the lawyers. If the guard see you and sounds the alarm Popov will run. And then he’ll disappear. And he won’t appear again anywhere where we could possibly get to him. Okay? So do it slow, do it quiet, do it right, and if you don’t, put him down quick when he starts running. Before it strikes a cheetah will spend hours crawling to its prey. The deposition has been secured. Get out of there now. All objectives complete. Good work everyone. Team 1 have made the drop. Documents secure.

finalOperation.dialogue:
Got a bit of a problem some asshole got wind of what we're up to. Apparently, killing a guy's closest associate puts a bit of a spotlight on him. Anyway, now I'm told they put a price on the professor's head, so we gotta move now. Is that clear? Can we get going? Alright. And remember, the professor's paying you, not me, not me at all, so keep him alive. Based on this inmate transfer schedule, Bolingbroke is expecting a new arrival. One of you is going to intercept the transport. Make sure it doesn't get there. Two of you are going to be taking our prison bus and make your way into the facility in its place. You'll be playing inmate and guards. Stay in character as long as it's useful, then make your way to the rooftops. I'll get on the radio and give you a path to the froth, meanwhile, the pilot will have picked up the plane and be waiting on the evac in the air. Whoever stole the bus will be bypassing the prison and torching it somewhere discreet. After that it's just a matter of getting your guy out of the clink and getting him onto the plane. Everyone flies out of there except for the bus thief. Professor Rashkovsky takes control of the plane. The three of you on board take a jump. The professor's out of US airspace and reunited with his precious car. Simple. Should be the easiest money you'll ever make. Speak soon.

Here we go. Okay, we're splitting into 2 teams. Transport Officer, you’re the ground team. To start, we’re going to collect our bus from the junkyard in Sandy Shores. Demolitions, you’re the perimeter team,  you’ll be hijacking the inbound Bolingbroke transport, the pilot's going to LSIA. And me, I'm gonna put up some smoke in a nice crowded public place. We’ve given everyone an AP pistol and a special combine so there's no fighting over who's the favorite demolitions has got a jerry can and some sticky bombs too. Let's get to work

Once the bus is secure, demolitions is driving it to Sandy Shores, the pilot is going to LSIA. We’ve paid them off at LSIA they’ll open the gate let you on the runways. 

You got the transport? Okay. It’s fitted with a geo locator so it needs to be going in vaguely the right direction. You’ll bypass the prison and take it to Sandy Shores Airfield where you will destroy it and wait for the jet. Do not track police attention or the entire operation will be burned. 

You got the bus? Alright, take it to Bolingbroke and avoid attention.

Ok get to it. As long as they think you’re an inmate they shouldn’t raise the alarm. I said shouldn’t. So much for that the facility is on alert. You move for Rashovsky. The prison is in lockdown, there is only one route to Rashovsky. Oh shit look out they called in Noose. The asset is downstairs in the yard, Transport, secure him. Officer, run interference. 

I thought they were sending professionals, I collaborate and nearly get shiv for the pleasure. Just give me the gun. There are some screws I hope we run into. Let’s go. 

Asset acquired. Get to the pickup. The paycheque is in your hands, Transporter. Protect Rashkovsky. Rashkovsky is not moving until we have some space here. He ain’t moving until the area is clear. Come on. You’re going out the way you came in; let’s go. We got a problem. Air traffic redflagged the plane, and they’re scrambling jets. Pilot, if they try to shut you down, run evasive maneuvers. Stay strong up there until the ground team gets Rashovsky out of the facility. The jets have gone offline. And, hey, it looks like the ground team have actioned the evac. Pilot, coordinate the pick-up. Demolition, do what you can do. We’re almost there, people. Pilot, they have the asset, coordinate with the ground team, choose a place to land, and pull them out of there. Okay. Get the plane out of there. Demolitions keep with them. When the rest of the crew bails, you’ll be picking them up. You need to evade the authorities before you bail out of there. Run evasive maneuvers, then head towards the drop zone. If this all goes to plan, you rendezvous on the beach in the Palomino Highlands. And remember, Rashkovsky is paying you to get him out. I’m just a friendly stranger you know very little about. 

Take me back to Cayo. So long. I hope they pay you good for this. 

I should say I’ve been impressed by your professionalism. I’m not going to go into it, but Rashkovsky’s part of something bigger. Way bigger. I need to make a few more inquiries, and we’ll be ready to go on a job that requires your particular skill set. Don’t retire on me just yet. Jump successful, pick ‘em up and get ‘em home.

roles.duties: Infiltrates disguised as an inmate, locates and frees Rashkovsky.
Partners with the Prisoner inside, helps escort Rashkovsky out.
Flies the stolen Velum, evacuates the ground team from Sandy Shores Airfield.
Intercepts an incoming prison bus, then provides air support in a Buzzard.

HUM-003.title: Humane Labs Raid

overview.target: Humane Labs and Research facility (Merryweather-operated, under Don Percival)
overview.objective: Infiltrate the Humane Labs facility and steal sensitive research data.

HUM-003.intel: Agent 14 lays out five setups: securing lab key codes, stealing armored Insurgents, taking a Hydra fitted with an EMP, seizing a Valkyrie attack helicopter, and driving the EMP into the facility grounds ahead of the raid itself.

setup.name: 1. Key Codes
setup.objective: Meet a contact downtown as Buyer and Bodyguard to obtain the lab's key codes, then fight out.

setup.name: 2. Insurgents
setup.objective: Steal two armored Insurgent LAPVs from a Merryweather test site.

setup.name: 3. EMP
setup.objective: Fight onto a Merryweather aircraft carrier to steal a Hydra jump jet fitted with an EMP device.

setup.name: 4. Valkyrie
setup.objective: Assault Merryweather's naval base to steal the Buckingham Valkyrie attack helicopter used in the finale.

setup.name: 5. Deliver EMP
setup.objective: Load the EMP into a stolen Insurgent and drive it into the Humane Labs grounds undetected.

roles.duties: Enters the facility with night vision and rebreathers to retrieve the target data.
Flies the Valkyrie for air support and evac.
Mans the Valkyrie's weapons, defends the ground team during extraction.

SER-004.title: Series A Funding

overview.target: Rival drug stashes across Los Santos and Blaine County
overview.objective: Steal drug stashes from rival gangs to sell for profit, then defend the haul at Trevor's warehouse.

SER-004.intel: Trevor runs five setup missions to gather product from various rival operations, then calls in the crew to defend the TPI Warehouse once every group he's stolen from figures out who's responsible.

setup.name: 1. Coke
setup.objective: Split into air and water teams to hit a yacht for a cocaine shipment.

setup.name: 2. Trash Truck
setup.objective: Collect drug-stashed trash bags from four locations around the city in teams of two.

setup.name: 3. Bikers
setup.objective: Raid a Lost MC stash.

setup.name: 4. Weed
setup.objective: Steal a weed shipment.

setup.name: 5. Steal Meth
setup.objective: Clear the O'Neil Brothers' farm, then escort a meth tanker off the property with two escort drivers.

roles.duties: Two players hold the north end, two hold the south, fending off waves of attackers at the TPI Warehouse.
Drive armed escort alongside the drug vans on the run to the drop-off, fending off pursuers.

PAC-005.title: The Pacific Standard Job

overview.target: Pacific Standard Public Deposit Bank — Downtown Vinewood
overview.objective: Rob the flagship branch of the Pacific Standard Bank and escape with the vault's contents.

PAC-005.intel: Lester's most ambitious job: five setups gather a disabling transponder, hacking equipment, thermal charges, and getaway bikes before the crew hits the bank itself.

setup.name: 1. Vans
setup.objective: Two teams (Driver + Navigator) use the Trackify app to locate and photograph Post OP vans, then steal the one Lester identifies.

setup.name: 2. Signal
setup.objective: Rescue signal expert Avi Schwartzman and deliver him to Paige so he can tune a transponder to disable the bank's dye packs.

setup.name: 3. Hack
setup.objective: Steal a hacking rig from a rival heist crew and swap it into your own van.

setup.name: 4. Convoy
setup.objective: Hijack a Merryweather convoy in Blaine County for thermal charges to breach the vault doors.

setup.name: 5. Bikes
setup.objective: Steal four Principe Lectro motorcycles from The Lost MC's East Los Santos clubhouse for the getaway.

roles.duties: Hacks the vault doors open.
Uses thermal charges to breach doors and security.
Two players hold the hostages and bank staff in the lobby.

DOOM-012.title: Act I — The Data Breaches

overview.target: Data on a series of breaches targeting sensitive government information
overview.objective: Investigate who's behind the breaches and feed the recovered data to Avon's AI, Clifford, for analysis.

DOOM-012.intel: Lester and tech billionaire Avon Hertz recruit the crew to track down a string of data breaches. Requires owning a Facility to unlock the planning room. Three prep missions unlock three setup missions before the finale.

setup.name: 1. Recover the Cache
setup.objective: Split into two teams — one retrieves a dead agent's data cache from LS County Coroners, the other recovers the agent's stolen helicopter.

setup.name: 2. Setup 2
setup.objective: Gather further equipment/intel per the prep board to unlock the finale.

setup.name: 3. Setup 3
setup.objective: Gather further equipment/intel per the prep board to unlock the finale.

roles.duties: Fights into the IAA facility to stop the server hack.
Provides cover and handles the war room gun camera to clear remaining enemies.

DOOM-013.title: Act II — The Bogdan Problem

overview.target: Bogdan — a rogue foreign agent operating an armed submarine off the San Andreas coast
overview.contact: Lester Crest / Avon Hertz / Agent ULP
overview.objective: Work with Agent ULP to track down and neutralize Bogdan before he can destabilize the region.

DOOM-013.intel: Escalates from Act 1 — Bogdan's submarine is the central threat. Five prep missions (Keycards, ULP Intel, Riot Control Van, Acquiring Strombergs, Acquiring Torpedo ECUs) unlock the setup chain.

setup.name: 1. Avenger
setup.objective: Secure an Avenger jet as a new mobile operations base.

setup.name: 2. Rescue ULP
setup.objective: Extract Agent ULP so they can assist with locating Bogdan.

setup.name: 3. Salvage Hard Drives
setup.objective: Recover hard drives with intel on Bogdan's operation.

setup.name: 4. Submarine Recon
setup.objective: Scout Bogdan's submarine ahead of the finale.

roles.duties: Handles aerial support during the assault on Bogdan's submarine.
Infiltrates the submarine directly to neutralize Bogdan.

DOOM-014.title: Act III — The Doomsday Scenario

overview.objective: Stop Avon Hertz and his AI Clifford from executing a plan to trigger a global cataclysm.

DOOM-014.intel: Avon Hertz is revealed as the true architect behind the conspiracy his own AI, Clifford, helped uncover. Six prep missions (including Marked Cash, Recon, and Test Site Intel) and five setups lead into the trilogy's climactic finale.

setup.name: 1. Escort ULP
setup.objective: Secure a Chernobog missile launcher and escort ULP to safety.

setup.name: 2-5. Remaining setups
setup.objective: Complete the remaining prep/setup chain (equipment acquisition tied to the TM-02 Khanjali test site and Avon's prototype Hydra) to unlock the finale.
setup.locations: Pacific Allied Shipyard and surrounding area

roles.duties: Fights through Avon's mountain base defenses.
Pursues and takes down Avon during the final confrontation.

CAS-016.title: Casino Story Missions

overview.objective: A string of introductory story missions around the newly opened casino, setting up the Diamond Casino Heist.

CAS-016.intel: These missions establish the casino's ownership by the Cheng family and introduce the Arcade property needed to plan the Diamond Casino Heist itself.

CAS-017.title: Diamond Casino Heist

overview.objective: Plan from a player-owned Arcade, then raid the vault using one of three approaches: Silent & Sneaky, The Big Con, or Aggressive.

CAS-017.intel: Vault contents rotate between cash, art, gold, or diamonds. Casino Scoping and Vault Contents preps are required for every run; six other preps are mandatory and seven are optional. The same approach can't be used twice in a row.

setup.name: Scoping
setup.objective: Photograph all access points and points of interest around the casino to unlock more finale options.

setup.name: Silent & Sneaky prep
setup.objective: Gather a support crew (Gunman, Driver, Hacker) and approach-specific gear like lasers for the vault door.

setup.name: The Big Con prep
setup.objective: Gather disguises and subterfuge tools — sneak in, then drill the vault once inside.

setup.name: Aggressive prep
setup.objective: Gather heavier weapons and armor for a direct assault entry.

roles.duties: Infiltrates via the chosen entry point (Staff Lobby, Waste Disposal, Roof Terrace, or Helipad).
Breaches the vault (hack, drill, or force depending on approach) and bags loot before the timer runs out.

CAY-019.title: Cayo Perico Heist
CAY-019.type: Kosatka-based heist, 1-4 players, first fully solo-capable heist

overview.target: Juan "El Rubio" Strickler's private island compound
overview.objective: Infiltrate El Rubio's island, steal a primary target plus optional secondary loot, and escape.

CAY-019.intel: The first GTA Online heist completable entirely solo. Planned from a player-owned Kosatka submarine. Gather Intel reveals the primary/secondary loot values and approach routes before prep begins.

planningLocation.observation: El Rubio's island has an extensive sonar network — approaching by submarine requires stealing a sonar jammer from a Merryweather sub first.

setup.name: Gather Intel
setup.objective: Reach the island's Communications Tower, hack the switchbox, and locate the primary target to reveal loot values and routes.

setup.name: Kosatka approach prep
setup.objective: Steal a sonar jammer from a Merryweather submarine to approach undetected by scuba gear.

setup.name: Alkonost / other approach preps
setup.objective: Optionally steal an RO-86 Alkonost or other approach vehicles (plane, boat) for alternate infiltration routes.

roles.duties: Enters the compound, reaches the underground vault, and steals the primary target plus any secondary loot.
Covers the infiltrator and helps carry additional loot before the escape.
